detail: The exact BioBioChile page S005 was assessed, then managed open returned an internal error and said URL not accessible; no body or denial reason was exposed and no retry was made. A distinct La Izquierda Diario report S007 was opened for the 19-Oct Temuco action, but has activist framing and reports ~700 versus Cooperativa S003 ~300. Count range is preserved; no claim of independent corroboration for the inaccessible result.

Search/open coverage lists multiple other cities (including Antofagasta, Copiapó, La Serena, Viña del Mar, Concepción and Iquique); many reports lack local counts or action-specific demands. No zero/absence is inferred; unquantified sites are not turned into count-qualified candidates.

The main 18-Oct Santiago assembly is strongly counted but opened accounts give broad social discontent, banners and plebiscite participation rather than a precise common target/demand for all participants. Nearby timeline actions and violence are kept separate.
The September 4 Plaza Dignidad action is prior-month context only. No continuity from that action to the October anniversary rallies is inferred.
